note: Re-judged 2026-10-01 under owner ruling 5 (ruling 2 reading). Ze never sends an ID_RFC822_ADDR: encodeIKEID (auth.go) emits only ID_IPV4_ADDR, ID_IPV6_ADDR or ID_FQDN, and the config path refuses a local-id/remote-id holding a terminator before it can be sent. The handling of the peer's violation is the refusal: TestWp2IDTerminatorRefused feeds refuseIDTerminators an ID_RFC822_ADDR holding a NUL and asserts refusal; TestWp2IDWithoutTerminatorAccepted is the control, a clean mail address accepted, so a check refusing every identity goes red. Tag labels are inverted relative to ruling 2 (refusal tagged positive, acceptance negative) but the pair is complete and isolated (one NUL octet is the only difference). Both units hold observed-red revert records.
upgrade_reason: No unit changed; the earlier weak verdict held that a receive-side refusal proves nothing Ze could violate. Owner ruling 5 (2026-09-30) rules the receive refusal of a terminator-bearing peer ID as this row's negative, and Ze's send side is confirmed by encodeIKEID never emitting the type.
